d: You will be responsible for the efficient running of the department in line with Hyatt International's Corporate Strategies and brand standards, whilst meeting employee, guest and owner expectations. The Security Manager is responsible to develop, implement, monitor and evaluate the hotel’s safety and security procedures, including fire safety, employee and asset protection.
q: Professional diploma or certification in Safety and Security, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years' experience as a Security Manager.
Strong practical and operational knowledge of security management.
Good administrative, leadership, and communication skills.
Ability to handle emergency situations effectively and make sound decisions under pressure.
